description: Complete the Mohist workflow implementation by fixing remaining issues: task status tracking, reviewer test improvements, prompt extraction, and user approval integration.

tasks.title: Add task status tracking in Build phase
tasks.description: Implement task status updates during Build phase execution. Track pending → in_progress → completed/failed status for each task in prd.json. Enable resuming from failed tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Task status field added to prd.json schema
Status transitions correctly: pending → in_progress → completed/failed
Timestamps recorded (startedAt, completedAt)
Attempt counts tracked for each task
Build phase can resume from failed tasks (skip completed)
TypeScript compilation passes
Unit tests for status updates
tasks.notes: Foundation for reliable Build phase execution

tasks.title: Improve Reviewer Agent test execution
tasks.description: Update Reviewer Agent to check package.json scripts and prioritize npm test over npm run build. Handle missing scripts gracefully.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads and parses package.json to detect available scripts
Runs 'npm test' if test script exists and is not default
Falls back to 'npm run build' if no test script
Returns skipped status if neither script exists
Test failures reported as correctness issues with output
5-minute timeout for test execution
TypeScript compilation passes

tasks.title: Extract Reviewer Prompt to YAML file
tasks.description: Move Reviewer Agent default prompt from embedded TypeScript string to YAML file in src/agents/prompts/ directory. Follow Planner Agent pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/agents/prompts/reviewer-default.yaml with complete prompt
Add loadReviewerDefaultPrompt() to prompt-loader.ts
ReviewerAgent loads prompt from file at runtime
Fallback to embedded default if file missing/corrupted
YAML structure includes all review dimensions
TypeScript compilation passes

tasks.title: Implement reliable user approval interface
tasks.description: Design and implement a reliable user approval mechanism for Plan and Review stages. Ensure approval flow cannot fail silently.
acceptanceCriteria: Approval state added to Issue type (pending, awaiting, approved, rejected)
execute_stage tool sets approval state when requiresApproval is true
submit_approval tool created for user to respond
Main Agent system prompt updated with approval flow instructions
State persisted in SQLite for recovery after crashes
Can resume from approval state on restart
Options: approve, request changes, abort
Clear presentation of approval request with context
End-to-end test passes for all three options
TypeScript compilation passes
tasks.notes: Critical for workflow reliability - prevents silent failures

tasks.title: Add comprehensive tests and documentation
tasks.description: Add unit tests for all modified components and update documentation with new workflow behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Unit tests for ChangeArtifactsManager.updateTaskStatus
Unit tests for ReviewerAgent.runTests with various scenarios
Unit tests for PromptLoader with missing/corrupted files
Unit tests for approval state transitions
Integration test for Build phase with task status updates
Integration test for Review phase with test execution
Integration test for complete approval flow
Documentation updated with new workflow features
All tests pass
Test coverage >80% for modified files
